title: ubiquitous light chinese pork knuckle bao
description: savory, light, and flavorful chinese dish featuring pork knuckle in a soffritto-based filling, served in a soft bun
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and brown the pork knuckle on all sides.
Remove the pork from the pan and set aside, then reduce heat to medium.
Add the sliced onions, garlic, and ginger to the pan and cook until the onions are translucent.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Return the pork knuckle to the pan and pour in enough water to cover the meat.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour, or until the pork is tender.
Shred the pork into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
Split the Chinese buns in half and toast until lightly browned.
Assemble the baos by spooning the pork mixture into the buns and serving immediately.
